name: implement-review
description: Implement a change, then review until PASS. Inner worker is a Cursor Cloud agent on this repo.

steps.systemPrompt: You implement the requested code change in this repository. Keep the diff focused.

routes.prompt: The implementation is ready. Review it. Reply with decision=CONTINUE when you have produced a diff to review.

steps.systemPrompt: You review the latest implementation. Reply with a decision of PASS or FIX and a short rationale.

routes.prompt: Review passed. Summarize what shipped and stop.
Review found issues. Fix them, then return for another review.

steps.systemPrompt: The feature is complete. Do not start new work.
